_note: Build-time defaults. serverUrl is the public LineRight Regbot site the app pairs with — the site that holds the bidding queue; this app looks for openings and books for its person against it. Empty means the app runs its own server (Practice on this computer, which needs a lineright-server checkout, and turns developer mode on). updateUrl is an optional self-hosted update feed. Choosing another server, practice or an update feed in Settings is part of developer mode (View → Developer mode, or --developer); REGBOT_SERVER_URL / REGBOT_UPDATE_URL (or --server=<url>, --practice) override them for one run without saving anything.
